**4 noun groups:**
- `entire session` (alias: `sessions`)
- `entire checkpoint` (aliases: `cp`, `checkpoints`)
- `entire agent`
- `entire doctor` (now a parent — bare runs the existing scan-and-fix flow)

**8 new subcommands:**
- `session current` — active session for cwd
- `agent list` / `agent add <name>` / `agent remove <name>`
- `checkpoint list` / `checkpoint show <id|sha>` / `checkpoint diff <a> <b>`
- `doctor logs [--tail|--follow]` / `doctor bundle [--out]`

**Top-level aliases preserved (silent, permanent):**
- `rewind` → `checkpoint rewind`
- `resume` → `session resume`
- `attach` → `session attach`
- `explain` → `checkpoint show` (smart-routes id/sha/session)
- `trace` → `doctor trace`
- `search` → `checkpoint search` (hidden alias)

**Deprecated (functional, one-time stderr warning):**
- `configure` → `agent`
- `reset` → `clean` (already had Cobra `Deprecated` field)

## Files

- `aliascmd.go` — `warnDeprecatedAliasOnce` (one-shot stderr warner)
- `session_current.go`, `checkpoint_group.go`, `checkpoint_diff.go`, `agent_group.go`, `doctor_logs.go`, `doctor_bundle.go` — new
- `sessions.go` — renamed Use to `session`, added Aliases, registered new children
- `doctor.go` — added `trace`/`logs`/`bundle` subcommands
- `setup.go` — `configure` prints one-time deprecation warning
- `root.go` — wired groups, kept silent top-level aliases, refreshed Getting Started text
- `CLAUDE.md` — added Command Layout section

## Test plan

- [x] `mise run lint` — green
- [x] `mise run test` (unit) — all packages pass
- [x] `mise run test:integration` — pass
- [x] `mise run test:e2e:canary` (Vogon) — 4/4 pass
- [ ] Manual smoke: `entire session list`, `entire agent list`, `entire checkpoint list`, `entire doctor logs --tail 50`, `entire doctor bundle`
- [ ] Manual: `entire configure --agent <name>` still works and prints deprecation hint once
- [ ] Manual: `entire rewind`, `entire resume`, `entire attach`, `entire explain`, `entire trace` still work

Closes #1061 once shipped.

+Reorganizes the flat top-level CLI around noun groups while preserving existing invocations. After merging current `main` and PR #1050, the command layout now has five domain groups: `session`, `checkpoint`, `agent`, `auth`, and `doctor`.
+
+The compatibility policy is explicit:
+- Same-parent shorthands use real Cobra aliases, e.g. `sessions`, `cp`, and `checkpoints`.
+- Cross-path backwards compatibility commands remain registered as top-level compatibility entrypoints because Cobra aliases cannot point from `entire rewind` to `entire checkpoint rewind`.
+- Deprecated aliases continue to work and warn where appropriate.
+
+Closes #1061 once shipped.
+
+## What Changed
+
+- Adds the noun-group command structure:
+  - `entire session` with `list`, `info`, `stop`, `current`, `attach`, `resume`
+  - `entire checkpoint` with `list`, `show`, `rewind`, `search`, `diff`
+  - `entire agent` with `list`, `add`, `remove`
+  - `entire auth` with `login`, `logout`, `status`, `list`, `revoke`
+  - `entire doctor` with `trace`, `logs`, `bundle`
+- Preserves legacy top-level commands such as `rewind`, `resume`, `attach`, `explain`, `trace`, and hidden `search`.
+- Keeps `sessions`, `cp`, and `checkpoints` as Cobra-native aliases and adds a regression test that fails if they become duplicate root commands.
+- Integrates PR #1050's auth command group into the new root layout without duplicating `hooks`.
+- Adds diagnostic and utility commands for checkpoint diffing, session current lookup, doctor logs, and doctor bundles.
+- Updates command-layout documentation in `CLAUDE.md`.
+
+## Verification
+
+- `go test ./cmd/entire/...`
+- `go test ./cmd/entire/cli`
+- `go test ./cmd/entire/cli/api ./cmd/entire/cli/auth`
+- `mise run check`
+- `mise run lint`
+
+Notes:
+- The first sandboxed `mise run check` failed because the sandbox blocked golangci-lint schema fetches, Go build-cache access, and local `httptest` ports. The same command passed outside the sandbox.
+- No paid real-agent E2E suite was run; `mise run check` ran the deterministic Vogon/Roger canaries.
*** End Patch
